title: Main is protected by one shared GitHub ruleset with a PR-only admin bypass
why: Batch 81's run broke on GitHub's side (startup_failure, stuck 2 h 15 min), and classic protection left the owner no clean way to merge it.
source: Owner 16:42 CST Nov 11 (interest, not a grant); coordinator 16:43 CST; page item 517
note: Owner 16:42 CST Nov 11: "id be pretty open to adding a ruleset" (interest, not a grant). Shared form: PR required; only all-jobs-passed required; 0 approvals; not strict; no linear history; no signed commits; bypass list = repository admin role in "pull requests only" mode, so the owner can merge a PR whose run GitHub broke while direct pushes stay blocked. Shared across repos, so it is a claude-settings decision (the shared-form record) plus the cloud-refused act the Oct 30 standing grant covers for branch protection; a grant that names rulesets is still owed. Page item 517 (one-check-ruleset, retrospective 16:42 CST) asks whether to move every repo to a ruleset in the child-repo sweep or reset the drifted repo now. Held for the fan-out (owner 13:51); the owner question at the fan-out: adopt yes/no. Owner 16:43 CST "r": rulesets everywhere, in the child-repo sweep. The PR-only admin bypass is not in that grant; it still needs the owner's yes at the fan-out. Lane prose-unmapped-5 started 07:29 CST Nov 12 (coordinator fan-out, Sonnet, medium).
